result.title: Differentiable Agent-Based Modeling for Multi-Echelon Supply Chains: Gradient-Based Optimization of Heterogeneous Policies at Scale
result.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 2026 Annual Modeling and Simulation Conference
result.summary: Global supply chains rely on the interactions of thousands of heterogeneous agents, posing significant challenges for optimization. While traditional optimization often assumes homogeneity to ensure tractability, Reinforcement Learning struggles with sample inefficiency when scaling to high-dimensional state spaces. We propose a Differentiable Agent-Based Model for multi-echelon inventory management. By implementing stochastic dynamics via differentiable tensor operations, we enable direct gradient propagation through the simulation. We validate the framework by recovering theoretical Newsvendor optima without supervision. Crucially, we demonstrate ``Mass Personalization'' by optimizing 10,000 distinct agent policies simultaneously in seconds, achieving a 53% cost reduction compared to scalar baselines. Furthermore, we utilize gradient sensitivity analysis to generate causal heatmaps, accurately recovering inherent lead-time delays from the computation graph. This approach bridges the gap between simulation and optimization, enabling the efficient training of self-correcting Digital Twins.

AI.brief_summary: 提出可微的 agent-based 多级库存仿真框架，用可微张量运算实现随机动态下的梯度反传，无监督恢复报童模型最优解，并同时优化一万个异质策略、借梯度敏感性生成因果热图。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉或多模态推理无直接关系，但其沿计算图做梯度敏感性归因、在长程随机动态中定位时序依赖的做法，可能可供核查 latent 轨迹的贡献分配与深度/位置效应诊断。
